Presiden Isaac Herzog resmi memberi tenggat waktu dua puluh delapan hari bagi Eisenkot untuk merangkul faksi-faksi yang berseberangan. 

Di tengah sengitnya penolakan internal yang membuat nasib takhta kepemimpinan Israel berada di ambang spekulasi panas.

snippet.title: POV: The Cancer Patient is Younger Than You
snippet.description:
Sources- PMID 42678893 
Diego | Travel Tech on TT 

Researchers attribute the rising rates of colorectal cancer in younger adults to modern diets, environmental exposures, and disrupted gut health. Diets high in ultra-processed foods and low in fiber, along with sedentary habits and early antibiotic use, alter gut bacteria. This imbalance promotes chronic inflammation and DNA damage, encouraging early polyp formation. Diagnostic delays also contribute to advanced cases in young people. Early warning signs like abdominal pain or rectal bleeding are frequently mistaken for minor issues like hemorrhoids. While genetic conditions explain a small fraction, most cases stem from environmental shifts interacting with subtle genetic factors.

snippet.title: When Abdul El-Sayed Was Brought to Tears
snippet.description:
While making the Not Going Quitely documentary, we filmed Ady Barkan with Abdul El-Sayed, who was running for governor of Michigan at the time.

Ady Barkan spent his last years fighting for Medicare for All, a cause Abdul has carried for just as long. Abdul rose to thank him and ended in tears, talking about how Ady’s fight kept him going on the hard days, and how missing his own daughter made him think of Ady and his son.
Ady, speaking through a voice he’d mostly lost to ALS, still managed to get a laugh out of the room before calling Abdul one of the most visionary political leaders he’d ever met.
